dispute_ticket.description: The driver asked me to cancel because he was stuck and I said no. He then cancelled himself and I was charged a S$6.00 cancellation fee. I was already late for my class and he was very curt with me. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: Can you cancel for me? I'm stuck, car problem.
No, I won't cancel. Please come, I'm late.

app_events.details: Rider R-7119 booked trip RYDE-DS-019; driver D-8119 assigned. Match time 13:00:00.
Cancelled by driver D-8119, reason selected: 'rider asked to cancel'. No cancel request from the rider is recorded for this booking.
Cancellation fee S$6.00 charged to rider (system treated the cancellation as rider-initiated after 3 min 50 s).
The rider app showed the trip as 'cancelled by you' for about 2 minutes, then updated to 'cancelled by driver'.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

fee_applies_to_driver_initiated_cancella.text: Governs whether the rider's cancellation fee applies when the driver is the party who cancels the booking.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The booking log shows the cancellation was made by the driver at 13:03:50 and records no cancel request from the rider. The chat shows the driver asking the rider to cancel at 13:02:20, the rider refusing at 13:02:50 and the driver cancelling at 13:03:40. This trip's policy says the cancellation fee does not apply to a driver-initiated cancellation, and the system wrongly treated it as rider-initiated after 3 min 50 s. The S$6.00 fee is refunded in full; the driver's curt tone and the temporary 'cancelled by you' label do not change that.
